title: Remote Service-Control Named Pipe Access Over SMB Admin Share
description:
Detects network share object access (Security EID 5145) to a service-execution named pipe over
the IPC$ administrative share. Remote binds to RPC pipes such as svcctl (Service Control
Manager), atsvc (Task Scheduler) or psexecsvc are the hallmark of PsExec / SMBExec style
lateral movement, where an attacker remotely creates and starts a service on the target to run
code. Because the logsource is service:security, EventID 5145 is asserted explicitly in the
selection.
sigma: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=5145 AND ShareName LIKE '%IPC$' ESCAPE '\' AND (RelativeTargetName='svcctl' OR RelativeTargetName='atsvc' OR RelativeTargetName='psexecsvc' OR RelativeTargetName='paexec' OR RelativeTargetName='remcomsvc' OR RelativeTargetName='csexecsvc')
